info.title: API.SH: eBird
info.description: The eBird API from API.SH: public eBird data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: eBird checklist
get.description:
One public checklist: date, protocol, duration, distance, party size, completeness, observer (`observer_name` as the site shows it; `observer` as first name and last initial), comments, location id and region, and every species with count, comments and breeding code.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-checklist

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Recent checklists in a region
get.description:
The latest checklists submitted in a region or hotspot (or on one date): checklist id, date and time, species count, observer (`observer_name` as the site shows it; `observer` as first name and last initial) and location (personal locations kept coarse).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-checklists

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: eBird region code or hotspot id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Birding hotspot
get.description:
One public eBird hotspot: name, coordinates, county, state, country, full place name and the number of species reported there.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-hotspot

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Hotspot id (L109516) or its ebird.org link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Prospect Park
example.hierarchical_name: Prospect Park, Kings, New York, US

get.summary: Birding hotspots in a county
get.description:
Public birding hotspots in a county-level region with coordinates, latest sighting date and all-time species count, sorted by species (default), name or latest activity. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null at the end.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-hotspots

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: County-level eBird region code, e.g. US-NY-047.

parameters.name: days_back
parameters.description: Only hotspots visited in the last N days (1-30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Birding hotspots near a point
get.description:
Public birding hotspots within a distance (up to 50 km) of a latitude/longitude, with latest sighting date and species count.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-hotspots-nearby

parameters.name: days_back
parameters.description: Only hotspots visited in the last N days.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Recent bird sightings in a region
get.description:
Recent bird sightings in a country, state, county or hotspot (latest per species by default, newest first): species, count, date, location, coordinates, validity and checklist. `species` for one species; `notable=true` for rare or unusual sightings (with the observer's display name in `observer_name`, plus `observer` as first name and last initial). Sightings at personal locations keep only the region and a coarse position.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-observations

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: eBird region code (US, US-NY, US-NY-047) or hotspot id (L109516), or an ebird.org region/hotspot link.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Taxonomic categories, comma-separated: species, slash, issf, spuh, hybrid, domestic, form, intergrade.

parameters.name: locations
parameters.description: Up to 10 region/hotspot codes to combine, comma-separated.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for common names, e.g. es, fr, pt_BR.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Bird sightings in a region on a date
get.description:
Bird sightings in a region on one past date (one row per species: latest or first report), with species, count, time, location, observer (`observer_name` as the site shows it; `observer` as first name and last initial) and checklist.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-observations-historic

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: eBird region code or hotspot id.

parameters.name: rank
parameters.description: mrec: latest report of each species (default); create: first report.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Recent bird sightings near a point
get.description:
Recent bird sightings within a distance of a latitude/longitude (up to 50 km), optionally for one species or only notable ones, with species, count, date, location and checklist.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-observations-nearby

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Nearest recent sightings of a species
get.description:
The closest recent sightings of one species to a latitude/longitude, nearest first.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-observations-nearest

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: eBird region
get.description:
One region: full name, type, parent, bounding box, centre and (for countries and states) the neighbouring regions.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-region

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: eBird region code or hotspot id.

parameters.name: name_format
parameters.description: detailed, detailednoqual, full (default), namequal, nameonly or revdetailed.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Birding stats for a region on a date
get.description:
How many checklists, contributors and species were reported in a region on one day.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-region-stats

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: eBird regions
get.description:
Countries, or the states/provinces or counties within a region, with their eBird codes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-regions

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Parent region code (required for subnational types), e.g. US or US-NY.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Bird species groups
get.description:
Species groups in taxonomic (ebird) or Merlin order, with the taxonomic-order ranges each covers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-species-groups

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Species ever reported in a region
get.description:
Every species ever reported in a region or hotspot, in taxonomic order, with common and scientific names, category, family and order.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-species-list

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: eBird region code or hotspot id.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Bird taxonomy lookup
get.description:
Species from the eBird/Clements taxonomy by code or by name search: common and scientific names, category, taxonomic order, banding codes, order and family.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-taxonomy

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Or a common or scientific name to search.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Top birders in a region on a date
get.description:
A region's top 100 contributors on one day, ranked by species or complete checklists (display name as the site shows it in `observer_name`, plus `observer` as first name and last initial).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/ebird-top-observers

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
